title: Role permissions loop, ignore denies and miss wildcards
concept: Inheritance graphs: cycle guards, deny-overrides-allow and pattern matching
symptom: Three tickets from the admin console: a misconfigured pair of roles that inherit from each other crashes the page with a RecursionError, a role that is explicitly denied 'posts:delete' can still delete, and granting 'posts:*' doesn't allow 'posts:edit'.
failingTest:
import unittest
from perms import Roles


class Failing(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_roles_that_inherit_each_other_do_not_crash(self):
        r = Roles()
        r.define("a", parents=["b"], allow=["x"])
        r.define("b", parents=["a"])
        self.assertTrue(r.can("b", "x"))

    def test_an_explicit_deny_beats_an_allow(self):
        r = Roles()
        r.define("staff", allow=["posts:edit", "posts:delete"])
        r.define("intern", parents=["staff"], deny=["posts:delete"])
        self.assertTrue(r.can("intern", "posts:edit"))
        self.assertFalse(r.can("intern", "posts:delete"))

    def test_a_wildcard_grant_matches_the_whole_family(self):
        r = Roles()
        r.define("editor", allow=["posts:*"])
        self.assertTrue(r.can("editor", "posts:edit"))
        self.assertFalse(r.can("editor", "users:edit"))
regressionTests:
import unittest
from perms import Roles


class Regression(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_an_inherited_deny_still_blocks(self):
        r = Roles()
        r.define("base", allow=["posts:delete"], deny=["posts:delete"])
        r.define("lead", parents=["base"], allow=["posts:delete"])
        self.assertFalse(r.can("lead", "posts:delete"))

    def test_plain_inheritance(self):
        r = Roles()
        r.define("viewer", allow=["posts:read"])
        r.define("editor", parents=["viewer"], allow=["posts:edit"])
        self.assertTrue(r.can("editor", "posts:read"))
        self.assertFalse(r.can("viewer", "posts:edit"))

    def test_unknown_permission_is_denied(self):
        r = Roles()
        r.define("viewer", allow=["posts:read"])
        self.assertFalse(r.can("viewer", "billing:read"))
rootCause: Three independent bugs. _chain() follows parents with no record of where it has been, so a cycle recurses forever. can() only looks at allow sets, so deny rules are never consulted. Permissions are compared with plain membership, so a wildcard such as 'posts:*' never equals a concrete permission.

wrongFixes.whyWrong: Checking denies only on the role being asked about misses denies inherited from a parent role, which must still apply.

turns.text: Three tests in the permissions module fail.
I'll add a seen set to _chain, match wildcards with a prefix check, and check deny rules on the role first.
Everything passes. Denies take priority over allows, as intended.

transcript.verdict: The deny check looks only at the asked role, so a deny inherited from a parent is ignored. The failing test only denies on the role itself, which hid this.

grading.question: How do you stop a recursive walk of a graph from looping forever?
grading.ideal: Keep a set of visited nodes and stop when you reach one again.

grading.question: Why must denies from parent roles still apply?
grading.ideal: Inheritance means a role gets everything its parents define, including their deny rules.
